key_highlights: David Jones collapses into voluntary administration, threatening thousands of retail jobs, mall anchor occupancies, and unpaid supplier balances.
Qantas flags a $1 billion surge in jet fuel costs, prompting flight cuts and airfare hikes that amplify transport inflation.
Australian housing market faces steepening downturn risks as restricted borrowing capacity mirrors New Zealand property declines.
ASX equity markets demonstrate resilience, finishing the week higher led by gold sector capital raisings and data centre infrastructure strength.

sectors.trend: Severe retail distress marked by the administration of David Jones and supplier payment freezes.
sectors.implications: Heightened default risk across retail supply chains and earnings downgrades for discretionary retailers.

sectors.trend: Structural anchor vacancy threats for shopping centre owners alongside broad residential price falls.
sectors.implications: Pressure on retail REIT net operating income (SCG.AX, VCX.AX) and softening valuations for residential developers.

sectors.trend: Jet fuel price pressures driving a $1 billion cost headwind for domestic aviation.
sectors.implications: Margin contraction and capacity constraints for Qantas (QAN.AX); relative cashflow support for upstream energy producers.

sectors.trend: Strong equity raising activity across gold producers and active exploration updates in critical minerals.
sectors.implications: Robust liquidity buffer for gold miners (NST.AX, EVN.AX) and selective speculative upside in junior explorers (BPM.AX, CHN.AX).

sectors.trend: Household borrowing capacity constraints intensifying property downturn concerns.
sectors.implications: Headwinds to mortgage loan growth and potential rise in bad debt provisioning for major Australian banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX).

sectors.trend: Consistent investor appetite for AI infrastructure and cloud capacity.
sectors.implications: Sustained valuation premium and market outperformance for digital infrastructure operators such as NEXTDC (NXT.AX).

key_themes: Severe household and discretionary consumer squeeze culminating in major corporate failures.
Real estate repricing across commercial mall footprints and residential lending portfolios.
Supply-side cost shocks in aviation and transport from elevated fuel inputs.
Sector rotation towards defensives, gold miners, and AI-leveraged digital infrastructure.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Retail Sector Insolvencies & Mall Tenant Losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight retail REITs exposed to department store anchors; focus on non-discretionary and grocery-anchored centres.
Maintain defensive stance on high-beta domestic banks; favour diversified financial institutions.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Aviation Margin Compression from Fuel Spikes
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce cyclical transport exposure; hedge with allocations to upstream energy producers.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight senior gold miners benefiting from robust capital availability and safe-haven demand.
opportunities.rationale: Strong balance sheets and active institutional support provide capital insulation against domestic stagflation risks.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate top-tier digital infrastructure and data centre providers.
opportunities.rationale: Structural cloud and AI demand decoupling NEXTDC from domestic consumer headwinds.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to major shopping centre REITs with high department store anchor exposure.
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones administration increases rent renegotiation pressure, vacancy durations, and repositioning capex.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim domestic airline holdings following multi-billion fuel expense revisions.
defensive_moves.rationale: Qantas faces margin erosion if airfare hikes suppress travel demand during broader consumer belt-tightening.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound trading for the ASX 200 (^AXJO) as retail distress and mortgage deceleration counterbalance mining and tech strength.
market_outlook.long_term: Cyclical recovery contingent on RBA monetary easing and stabilising household disposable income, with resources well-positioned.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decisions and forward guidance on inflation
Administration proceedings and asset sales regarding David Jones
Australian housing market clearance rates and mortgage arrears data
Global energy prices and crude refining margins
watch_list: RBA policy statements and trimmed mean CPI figures
CoreLogic 5-capital city home value index trends
Commercial real estate occupancy and re-leasing spreads
AUD/USD exchange rate and international bullion prices
